title: supabaseCollectionOptions()
description: Builds the configuration for a TanStack DB collection backed by a Postgres table. Pass the result to `createCollection()` from `@tanstack/react-db`.

params.name: tableName
params.description: The Postgres table this collection reads from and writes to.

params.name: keys
params.description: The primary key column(s) for the table.

params.name: schema
params.description: A schema used to validate and type each row.

params.name: supabase
params.description: The Supabase client instance to query and subscribe through.

params.name: queryClient
params.description: An existing TanStack Query client to share, if you already use one.

params.name: realtime
params.description: Keep the collection in sync across clients using Supabase Realtime.

params.name: realtimeUseFilter
params.description: Apply server-side filtering to realtime updates instead of filtering on the client. Defaults to `false`.

notes:
- Realtime sync is experimental.
- Collections work with an existing Supabase project and respect Row Level Security. No migrations required.
